products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full suite of commercial banking products including demand deposit accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, commercial loans, lines of credit, and related services. These are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Personal banking products such as checking and savings accounts, debit cards, cashier’s checks, and safe deposit rental facilities, delivered through branches and digital platforms. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person or digital service.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination, purchase, and servicing of residential real estate loans, home equity lines of credit, and construction mortgages, including both adjustable and fixed-rate loans. Loans are originated, sometimes sold in the secondary market, and also purchased from partner companies. Requires financial capital, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans including installment loans for automobiles, boats, recreational vehicles, and personal lines of credit. Delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Fintech Banking Services
products.description: Specialized banking services for corporate Fintech clients, including operational risk management, compliance, and banking relationships for payments, banking-as-a-service, and gaming industries. Delivered by a dedicated Fintech team, leveraging regulated banking infrastructure and technology integration.

products.name: Mortgage Banking (via Equity Investments)
products.description: Participation in mortgage banking activities through equity method investments in companies focused on residential and commercial loan origination and servicing. Revenue is derived from share of net income or loss from these investments.

products.name: Fraud Prevention Services
products.description: Customizable fraud prevention services for merchants, credit agencies, Fintech companies, and other vendors, delivered through Paladin Fraud subsidiary. Involves digital tools and professional expertise to help clients defend against threats.

products.name: Professional Consulting Services for Banks and Fintechs
products.description: Professional consulting services, primarily for banks and Fintech companies, including advisory and operational support. Delivered by specialized teams and subsidiaries, requiring human expertise and industry knowledge.

products.name: Digital Banking and Software Services (historical, via Victor and Trabian)
products.description: Development and provision of digital products, web and mobile applications, and software services for banks, credit unions, and Fintech companies. Previously delivered through Victor and Trabian subsidiaries, involving software development and digital delivery. Note: Victor and Trabian were divested in 2025.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and construction and development loans. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and require significant underwriting, regulatory compliance, and capital allocation.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgage loans, home equity loans, and lines of credit to consumers, including both in-house and secondary market mortgage products. These are originated through branch and digital channels and require regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides personal loans to individuals for household and personal purposes, including secured and unsecured installment loans and revolving lines of credit. These are delivered through branch and digital channels and require credit assessment and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a full suite of deposit products to individuals, businesses, and organizations, including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, retirement accounts, and health savings accounts. These are delivered through branch, online, and mobile channels and require regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online, mobile, and telephone banking services to retail and commercial customers, enabling digital access to accounts, transactions, and banking products. These are delivered via proprietary digital platforms and require ongoing technology investment and cybersecurity.

products.name: Mortgage Banking (Secondary Market)
products.description: Engages in mortgage banking activities, including originating and selling residential mortgages into the secondary market through agencies such as Fannie Mae and the Federal Home Loan Bank. This requires specialized underwriting, compliance, and capital management.

products.name: Investment Services
products.description: Provides investment and safekeeping services to customers, including management of securities portfolios comprised of government, municipal, and corporate securities. Delivered through a subsidiary and requires regulatory compliance and financial expertise.

products.name: Insurance Services (via Affiliate)
products.description: Offers insurance products and services to customers through a minority ownership in Ansay & Associates, one of the nation’s largest independent insurance providers. Delivered via partnership rather than in-house operations.

products.name: Title Services (via Affiliate)
products.description: Provides access to title insurance and related services through a minority ownership in Generations Title, LLC. Delivered via partnership rather than direct operations.

products.name: Infrastructure Modeling and Simulation Software
products.description: A comprehensive suite of cloud-connected desktop and digital-twin native applications for 2D/3D modeling, simulation, and analysis of infrastructure assets across sectors such as roads, bridges, buildings, water systems, plants, rail, tunnels, utilities, and more. Delivered primarily as software requiring professional expertise, supporting open standards and interoperability.

products.name: Geotechnical and Subsurface Modeling Software
products.description: Software applications for modeling, simulation, and management of geotechnical and subsurface data, enabling detailed understanding of near and deep subsurface conditions for infrastructure and resource projects. Delivered as specialized software for geoprofessionals and engineers.

products.name: Enterprise Infrastructure Information Management (Bentley Infrastructure Cloud)
products.description: Cloud and hybrid enterprise software for managing engineering information, collaboration, and workflows across the infrastructure lifecycle, including project delivery, construction, and asset operations. Delivered as SaaS and hybrid solutions for organizations managing large infrastructure portfolios.

products.name: Asset Analytics and Digital Twin Solutions
products.description: AI-powered software and analytics tools for real-time monitoring, analysis, and optimization of infrastructure asset performance, leveraging digital twins and IoT data. Delivered as cloud-based analytics platforms and specialized applications for asset owners and operators.

products.name: Infrastructure Digital Twin Platform (Cesium and iTwin Platform)
products.description: A cloud-native platform and developer ecosystem for creating, curating, and leveraging infrastructure digital twins, integrating 3D geospatial, engineering, operational, and enterprise data. Delivered as a platform for both internal products and third-party developer applications.

products.name: Specialized Infrastructure Engineering Services
products.description: Professional and advisory services to support implementation, optimization, and adoption of Bentley software and digital workflows, including structured engagements (Blueprints), cloud implementation, and digital transformation advisory. Delivered by domain experts, both virtually and in-person, often bundled with enterprise subscriptions.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: Facilitates the buying, selling, and leasing of residential properties through a network of licensed agents, using a cloud-based, technology-driven platform. Services are delivered digitally and through in-person agent labor, with revenue primarily from agent-paid transaction fees.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides brokerage services for commercial property transactions, leveraging the same agent network and technology platform as residential services. Delivered through licensed agents and digital tools.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers mortgage origination and brokerage services to real estate clients, primarily through the Encompass Lending brand, integrating with the proprietary technology platform for streamlined transactions. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Title and Settlement Services
products.description: Provides title insurance and settlement services for real estate transactions, primarily through the Verus Title brand, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person coordination.

products.name: Real Estate Technology Platform (intelliAgent) Licensing
products.description: Licenses the proprietary intelliAgent cloud-based software platform to independent brokerages, offering transaction management, CRM, marketing, and compliance tools. Delivered digitally as SaaS.

products.name: Agent Support and Marketing Services (Elevate Program)
products.description: Provides agents with marketing resources, lead generation tools, transaction coordination, coaching, and recruiting assistance, both as part of internal agent support and as a licensable service to external brokerages. Delivered digitally and through human support.

products.name: Home Furnishings
products.description: A full range of home furnishing products including furniture and accents, manufactured primarily in North America with a focus on quality craftsmanship and customization, sold through retail design centers and online.

products.name: Complimentary Interior Design Services
products.description: Personalized interior design services provided by professional designers, offered both in-person at design centers and virtually, leveraging technology such as 3D room planners and augmented reality apps to create custom home solutions.

products.name: White Glove Home Delivery Services
products.description: Premium home delivery services that include preparation and delivery of products into clients’ homes, supported by a network of company-operated and third-party delivery centers.

products.name: Government Contract Furniture Sales
products.description: Sales of home furnishings and furniture to government entities, including through GSA Multiple Award Schedule Contracts and competitive bids, based on commercial price lists.

products.name: Digital Advertising Solutions
products.description: A suite of digital advertising products and services, including display, programmatic, and video ads, delivered across BuzzFeed's owned and operated sites and third-party platforms. These are enabled by proprietary data and technology to target and engage large, young audiences at scale.

products.name: Custom Content Creation and Licensing
products.description: Creation and distribution of custom digital content for clients, including branded quizzes, videos, feature films, micro-dramas, and content licensing. Content is produced by BuzzFeed's editorial and creative teams using proprietary technology and audience insights.

products.name: Affiliate Commerce and Editorial Shopping Content
products.description: Editorial shopping content that drives affiliate transactions for e-commerce partners, earning commissions on sales initiated from BuzzFeed's content. Delivered digitally through articles, lists, and recommendations, leveraging audience trust and reach.

products.name: Product Licensing and Merchandising
products.description: Licensing of BuzzFeed brands and intellectual property to third-party retailers and partners for use in consumer products and merchandise, generating revenue through licensing agreements.

products.name: AI-Enabled Interactive Content and Tools
products.description: Development and incubation of AI-powered applications and interactive storytelling tools, focused on new content formats and creative self-expression, delivered digitally to audiences and creators.

products.name: Residential Homebuilding
products.description: Designs, constructs, markets, and sells single-family detached homes, attached townhomes, condominiums, urban infill, and active lifestyle homes in planned residential developments. Homes are physically built and delivered to customers in various U.S. markets, requiring land acquisition, site development, construction, and sales operations.

products.name: Mortgage Origination Services
products.description: Provides mortgage loans to homebuyers purchasing homes from the company. The service includes loan application, approval, and closing, and is integrated into the home sales process. Loans are originated and then sold to institutional investors.

products.name: Title Services
products.description: Offers title services to homebuyers as part of the home purchase process, facilitating the transfer of property ownership and ensuring clear title. This service is delivered alongside mortgage origination to streamline the closing process for customers.

products.name: Build-For-Rent Home Sales
products.description: Constructs and sells homes specifically for institutional buyers or investors for the purpose of rental, supplementing the traditional for-sale business. Homes are physically built and delivered to third-party buyers for rental purposes.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of fixed-rate one-to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily secured by owner-occupied properties in the local market area. Loans are underwritten to internal credit policy guidelines and typically retained in the bank's portfolio.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of residential and commercial construction loans, including construction/permanent loans and land development loans, primarily for individuals and builders. Loans are secured by real estate and involve property inspections and appraisals.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to businesses for the purchase or refinance of commercial and other non-residential real estate, including investment properties. Loans are typically fixed-rate with amortization periods up to 25 years and secured by real estate.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Origination and purchase of commercial and industrial loans, including loans purchased from third parties and government-guaranteed loans. These loans are typically secured by business assets and are used for business development, working capital, and equipment purchases.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Origination of fixed-rate home equity loans and variable-rate home equity lines of credit, secured by residential real estate. Products offer various terms and are underwritten based on loan-to-value ratios and borrower creditworthiness.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination and purchase of consumer loans, including share loans secured by deposit accounts and purchased consumer loans from third parties. The bank does not originate automobile or similar consumer loans.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a range of deposit accounts to retail and commercial customers, including savings accounts, checking accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. Accounts are managed through physical branches and digital channels.

products.name: Electronic Banking Services
products.description: Provision of digital banking services such as mobile banking, online banking, telephone banking, bill pay, and electronic funds transfer via SmartPay®. These services are delivered through digital platforms and support account management and transactions.

products.name: Oncology Molecular Diagnostic Testing
products.description: A portfolio of DNA and RNA-based laboratory tests for cancer risk assessment, therapy selection, prognosis, and monitoring, including hereditary cancer panels, companion diagnostics, tumor profiling, and molecular residual disease (MRD) detection. Tests are performed in CLIA-certified labs using next-generation sequencing and other molecular techniques, and results are delivered to healthcare providers to guide patient management.

products.name: Prenatal and Reproductive Genetic Testing
products.description: Comprehensive laboratory-developed tests for prenatal screening, carrier screening, and fetal risk assessment, including non-invasive prenatal screening (NIPS), expanded carrier screening, and multi-modal prenatal panels. Tests use maternal blood or cheek swabs, leverage whole genome sequencing and proprietary technologies, and are designed to assess fetal chromosomal disorders, inherited conditions, and feto-maternal compatibility.

products.name: Mental Health Pharmacogenomic Testing
products.description: DNA genotyping laboratory tests that analyze patient genetic variants to inform and optimize selection and dosing of psychotropic medications for conditions such as depression, anxiety, and ADHD. Tests are performed using a cheek swab sample and results are provided to clinicians to guide medication choices based on individual genetic profiles.

products.name: Early Gender DNA Testing
products.description: A non-invasive blood-based laboratory test that uses cell-free DNA technology and proprietary algorithms to predict fetal sex as early as six weeks of gestation. The test is marketed directly to consumers and healthcare providers, with results delivered digitally.

products.name: Biopharma and Companion Diagnostic Services
products.description: Services for biopharmaceutical partners including biomarker identification and validation, companion diagnostic test development, regulatory registration, and commercialization. These services leverage Myriad's laboratory infrastructure, scientific expertise, and regulatory experience to support drug development and precision medicine initiatives.

products.name: Cyber and Electronic Warfare Solutions
products.description: Integrated solutions and products for full-spectrum cyber operations and electronic warfare, including vulnerability research, defensive and offensive cyber tools, and electromagnetic spectrum dominance. Delivered through a combination of software, hardware, and technical services, primarily to government and defense customers.

products.name: Space and Missile Defense Systems
products.description: Hardware, software, and engineering services supporting space operations, satellite ground systems, missile defense, and command and control systems. Includes integration, operations, and as-a-service models for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Critical Infrastructure Protection Solutions
products.description: Holistic security solutions for critical infrastructure, including electronic security systems, counter unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS), biometrics, border security, and cybersecurity. Delivered through integrated hardware, software, and engineering services to protect physical and digital assets.

products.name: Environmental Remediation and Emerging Contaminant Solutions
products.description: Services and technologies for remediation of hazardous, toxic, and emerging contaminants (e.g., PFAS), including soil, groundwater, and fire suppression systems. Delivered through engineering, patented technologies, and field operations for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Transportation Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Planning, design, engineering, and digital solutions for transportation infrastructure, including roads, highways, bridges, tunnels, rail, and transit systems. Delivered through program management, advanced engineering, and digital platforms for public and private sector clients globally.

products.name: Intelligent Transportation and Traffic Management Systems
products.description: Advanced digital solutions and platforms for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), including traffic management, smart mobility, and vehicle analytics. Delivered via proprietary software (e.g., iNET™ platform) and integration services to government and transportation authorities.

products.name: Aviation Infrastructure and Modernization Services
products.description: Program management, design, and engineering services for airport infrastructure, including terminal design, landside access, and modernization projects. Delivered through large-scale project management and advanced engineering for global airport clients.

products.name: Rail and Transit Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Design, engineering, and program management for rail and transit systems, including communications-based train control, station and facility design, and zero-emission bus infrastructure. Delivered through specialized engineering and digital solutions for public transit agencies.

products.name: Water and Wastewater Treatment Solutions
products.description: Engineering, design, and program management for water and wastewater treatment and conveyance systems, including modernization, resiliency, and environmental compliance. Delivered through advanced technologies and field services for municipal and industrial clients.

products.name: Urban Development and Smart City Solutions
products.description: Program management, urban planning, and digital solutions for large-scale urban development, smart cities, and mixed-use developments. Delivered through multidisciplinary design, digital platforms, and sustainability-focused engineering for public and private sector clients.

products.name: Program and Construction Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive program, project, and construction management services for complex infrastructure and defense projects, ensuring delivery within technical, quality, time, and cost parameters. Delivered through in-person expertise and digital tools for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Advanced Security and Identity Management Solutions
products.description: Integrated security solutions including biometrics, bio surveillance, and advanced electronic security systems for border security, infectious disease control, and identity management. Delivered through proprietary hardware, software, and field services for government and critical infrastructure clients.

products.name: Claims Management and Adjusting Services
products.description: Comprehensive claims management and adjusting services for property, casualty, liability, automobile, and marine insurance claims, delivered through a global network of field investigators and technical experts. Services are provided to insurance carriers and self-insured entities, involving in-person investigation, evaluation, and resolution of claims.

products.name: Third Party Administration (TPA) Services
products.description: Administration of insurance claims and risk management for corporations, brokers, and insurers, including claims intake, desktop adjusting, loss fund administration, and risk management information services. Delivered through specialized teams and technology platforms, primarily for workers' compensation, liability, property, accident & health, and disability claims.

products.name: Medical Management Services
products.description: Medical case management, bill review, vocational rehabilitation, and physician review services for insurance claims, using clinical expertise and technology to optimize outcomes and control costs. Delivered by clinical professionals and technology platforms to manage medical treatments and assess necessity.

products.name: Managed Repair and Contractor Network Services
products.description: Managed repair services for property insurance claims using a large network of credentialed contractors, providing outsourced contractor management and repair coordination for residential and commercial properties. Delivered through a proprietary contractor network and digital platforms.

products.name: Catastrophe Response and Staffing Services
products.description: Catastrophe claims management and temporary staffing (staff augmentation) for insurance companies, providing rapid deployment of adjusters and resources in response to natural and man-made disasters. Delivered through a network of trained adjusters and staffing solutions.

products.name: Subrogation Services
products.description: Outsourced subrogation claims management and recovery services for property and casualty insurance companies, including consultative services to maximize recoveries. Delivered by specialized teams using proprietary processes and technology.

products.name: Legal Services for Claims
products.description: Legal services related to insurance claims handling, including claims-related legal advice and representation, primarily in international markets. Delivered by in-house legal professionals as part of the claims process.

products.name: ADHD Therapeutics
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), including central nervous system stimulant medications such as Jornay PM, which is an FDA-approved, evening-dosed, extended-release methylphenidate product. These products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed primarily to wholesalers and retail pharmacies.

products.name: Extended-Release Opioid Analgesics
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products for the management of moderate to severe chronic pain, including abuse-deterrent, extended-release oral formulations such as Xtampza ER (oxycodone) and Nucynta ER (tapentadol). These products are manufactured using proprietary or licensed technologies and are distributed through wholesalers to retail and institutional customers.

products.name: Immediate-Release Opioid Analgesics
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products for the management of acute pain, including immediate-release oral formulations such as Nucynta IR (tapentadol). These products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed through wholesalers to retail and institutional customers.

products.name: Opioid-Induced Constipation Therapeutics
products.description: Prescription pharmaceutical products for the treatment of opioid-induced constipation (OIC) in adult patients with chronic non-cancer pain, such as Symproic (naldemedine), an oral formulation. These products are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed through wholesalers and retail pharmacies.

products.name: Hotel Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of upper upscale and luxury hotels located in convention, urban, and resort destinations. The company acquires, owns, and leases hotels, which are operated by third-party managers under long-term management agreements. Revenue is generated primarily from hotel operations managed by these third parties.

products.name: EsoGuard Esophageal DNA Test
products.description: A laboratory-developed, bisulfite-converted targeted next-generation sequencing (NGS) DNA assay performed on esophageal cell samples to detect methylation biomarkers associated with esophageal precancer and cancer. The test is processed in CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited laboratories and is delivered to healthcare providers and patients through various channels, including Lucid Test Centers, satellite programs, and telemedicine partnerships.

products.name: EsoCheck Esophageal Cell Collection Device
products.description: A proprietary, FDA 510(k)-cleared, CE Mark certified, noninvasive swallowable balloon capsule catheter device designed for in-office targeted sampling of surface esophageal cells. The device is physically manufactured by contract partners and distributed to healthcare providers for use in collecting samples for diagnostic testing, including EsoGuard.

products.name: PROBODY Antibody-Drug Conjugate Therapeutics (e.g., Varsetatug Masetecan/Varseta-M)
products.description: Conditionally activated antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) designed using the PROBODY platform to selectively deliver cytotoxic payloads to tumor cells, manufactured as recombinant biologics with specialized masking and linker technology, and delivered intravenously for the treatment of solid tumors such as colorectal cancer and potentially other EpCAM-expressing cancers.

products.name: PROBODY Cytokine Therapeutics (e.g., CX-801)
products.description: Conditionally activated, masked cytokine therapies (such as interferon alpha-2b) engineered using the PROBODY platform to be preferentially active in the tumor microenvironment, produced as recombinant biologics with dual masking to reduce systemic toxicity, and administered to treat cancers like melanoma and potentially other solid tumors.

products.name: PROBODY T-cell Engager Therapeutics (TCEs)
products.description: Conditionally activated, masked T-cell engaging bispecific antibodies developed using the PROBODY platform, designed to direct T-cells to kill tumor cells with reduced off-tumor toxicity, produced as recombinant biologics and advanced through internal and partnered preclinical and clinical programs.

products.name: PROBODY mRNA-based Therapeutics
products.description: mRNA-based therapies encoding conditionally activated, masked biologics (such as antibodies or cytokines) developed in collaboration with partners, leveraging the PROBODY platform and mRNA/lipid nanoparticle technologies for potential use in oncology and non-oncology indications.

products.name: U.S. Options Trading Platforms
products.description: Operation of four fully automated electronic options exchanges (MIAX Options, MIAX Pearl Options, MIAX Emerald Options, MIAX Sapphire Options) for trading multi-listed and proprietary U.S. equity options, delivered via proprietary high-performance technology and both electronic and physical trading floor access.

products.name: U.S. Equities Trading Platform
products.description: Operation of MIAX Pearl Equities, a fully automated electronic cash equities exchange offering trading in all U.S. equity securities under Regulation NMS, leveraging proprietary technology for high-speed, low-latency execution.

products.name: U.S. Futures and Options on Futures Trading and Clearing
products.description: Operation of MIAX Futures, a fully electronic, vertically integrated futures exchange and clearing house, listing and clearing agricultural and financial futures and options on futures, supported by proprietary technology and DCM/DCO licenses.

products.name: Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) Services
products.description: Provision of futures execution and clearing services for introducing brokers, retail customers, institutional clients, and professional traders through Dorman Trading, a registered FCM and clearing member of major U.S. and international futures exchanges.

products.name: International Securities Listing and Trading (Bermuda Stock Exchange)
products.description: Listing and trading of international capital market instruments such as equities, debt issues, funds, hedge funds, derivative warrants, and insurance-linked securities (ILS) on the fully electronic Bermuda Stock Exchange (BSX), with integrated trading, clearing, and settlement.

products.name: International Securities Listing and Trading (The International Stock Exchange)
products.description: Listing and trading of securities including high yield bonds, private equity debt, securitization bonds, investment funds, and UK REITs on The International Stock Exchange (TISE), serving global issuers and investors, with a focus on the European and UK markets.

products.name: Proprietary Index-Based Derivatives (Bloomberg Products)
products.description: Development and exclusive listing of proprietary index-based derivatives, including futures, options on futures, and cash-settled index options on Bloomberg indexes (B500 Index, B500 Volatility Index, B100Q Index), to be traded on affiliated exchanges under a ten-year exclusive license.

products.name: Market Data and Analytics Products
products.description: Provision and commercialization of proprietary market data and analytics products derived from trading activity on MIAX exchanges, including select data published to decentralized networks and exclusive data offerings for customers.

products.name: Cardiac Rhythm and Heart Failure Devices and Therapies
products.description: Implantable devices (pacemakers, ICDs, CRTs), cardiac ablation systems, insertable cardiac monitors, antibacterial envelopes, and remote monitoring software for diagnosis, treatment, and management of heart rhythm disorders and heart failure. Products are manufactured medical devices, often implanted or used in clinical settings, with digital monitoring and support services.

products.name: Structural Heart and Aortic Therapies
products.description: Devices and implants for repair and replacement of heart valves (transcatheter and surgical), perfusion systems, surgical ablation, and endovascular stent grafts for aortic disease. Products are manufactured medical devices used in surgical and interventional procedures.

products.name: Coronary and Peripheral Vascular Therapies
products.description: Stents, balloons, catheters, atherectomy devices, and closure systems for the treatment of coronary artery disease, peripheral vascular disease, and venous disease. Products are manufactured medical devices used in minimally invasive vascular procedures.

products.name: Cranial and Spinal Technologies
products.description: Devices, implants, biologics, and surgical technologies for neurological and spinal procedures, including navigation, imaging, robotic guidance, and spinal implants. Products are manufactured medical devices and digital systems used in surgery and treatment of neurological and musculoskeletal conditions.

products.name: Neurovascular, ENT, and Pelvic Health Therapies
products.description: Devices and therapies for treatment of neurovascular diseases (stroke, aneurysms), ear, nose, and throat conditions, and pelvic health (overactive bladder, urinary retention). Products include stent retrievers, embolization devices, aspiration systems, ENT surgical tools, and neurostimulators. Manufactured medical devices used in interventional and surgical procedures.

products.name: Neuromodulation Therapies
products.description: Spinal cord and brain stimulation systems, implantable drug infusion pumps, and interventional pain and tumor treatment devices. Products are manufactured implantable and external devices for chronic pain, movement disorders, and related neurological conditions.

products.name: Surgical and Endoscopy Products
products.description: Advanced stapling devices, vessel sealing instruments, wound closure products, electrosurgery equipment, robotic-assisted surgery systems, hernia repair devices, and endoscopy solutions. Products are manufactured medical devices and digital platforms used in surgical and minimally invasive procedures.

products.name: Acute Care and Patient Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Patient monitoring systems, airway management devices, and respiratory monitoring products for use in hospitals and care centers. Products include pulse oximetry, brain monitoring, capnography, and airway tubes. Manufactured medical devices and digital monitoring systems.

products.name: Diabetes Management Systems
products.description: Insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems, and smart insulin pens for management of Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes. Products are manufactured medical devices and digital platforms for continuous and connected diabetes care, used by patients and healthcare providers.

products.name: Cyber Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Platform (Xacta)
products.description: A software platform that automates cyber risk management and security compliance processes for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, supporting a wide range of regulatory frameworks. Delivered as a digital solution, it leverages AI for compliance automation and proactive risk management.

products.name: Cybersecurity Services
products.description: Professional services covering the full cybersecurity lifecycle, including consulting, security assessment and compliance, engineering, operations, penetration testing, and digital forensics. Delivered by certified personnel, these services require in-person human labor and expertise.

products.name: Secure Messaging Platform (Telos AMHS)
products.description: A web-based organizational message distribution and management solution for mission-critical communications, primarily used by government and military customers. Delivered as a software platform with specialized protocols for secure, reliable, and timely communications.

products.name: Identity and Biometric Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of solutions for secure identity verification, biometric enrollment, and trusted identity services, including TSA PreCheck enrollment, FBI background check submission, and proprietary biometric authentication technology. Delivered via workstations, kiosks, mobile devices, and enterprise platforms, requiring both digital infrastructure and physical enrollment.

products.name: Secure Network Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive secure networking architectures and solutions, including wired and wireless, fixed and deployable, classified and unclassified voice, data, and video networks. Delivered through physical infrastructure, system integration, and engineering for defense and civilian missions.

products.name: Secure Mobility Solutions
products.description: Solutions and professional services enabling secure off-premise work and integrated communications for business and government, including consulting and deployment services. Delivered through a combination of network engineering, mobility, and security expertise.

products.name: Managed Network Management and Defense Services
products.description: Managed services for operating, maintaining, and defending complex enterprise networks, ensuring system and network availability, information protection, and assured information delivery. Delivered by network engineers and cybersecurity specialists using advanced tools and best practices.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans including commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate loans, construction and development loans, and agricultural loans to businesses, public sector, non-profits, and individuals. These loans are originated and serviced through in-person banking offices and require significant underwriting, collateral management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers residential real estate loans, including home equity loans and short-term mortgages, primarily to individuals. Most long-term mortgages are sold to other parties with servicing rights retained, requiring origination, underwriting, and servicing infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides consumer loans such as personal loans (secured or unsecured) and automobile loans to individuals, delivered through branch offices and digital channels. These loans are typically smaller, shorter-term, and require credit assessment and servicing.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a variety of deposit accounts including checking, savings, money market, and time deposits to individuals, businesses, and organizations. These products are delivered through branch offices, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, and require regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Treasury Management and Payment Services
products.description: Provides treasury management, online and mobile banking, Zelle, debit cards, and ATM services to business and retail customers. These services are delivered digitally and through physical infrastructure, supporting cash management and payment needs.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Services
products.description: Offers wealth management services including estate, trust, and conservatorship administration, financial planning, investment advisory, brokerage, property management, and custodial services. Delivered by licensed professionals through select branches and digital channels, requiring regulatory compliance and specialized expertise.

products.name: Retail Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of multi-tenant retail properties, primarily grocery-anchored neighborhood and community centers, and power centers in Sun Belt markets. This involves owning, managing, and redeveloping physical retail real estate and providing space to external tenants under lease agreements.

products.name: Clinical Research Services
products.description: Comprehensive clinical trial management and support services, including protocol design, site identification, patient recruitment, clinical monitoring, and laboratory services, delivered globally through a combination of technology, data, and in-person expertise.

products.name: Real World Evidence and Data Solutions
products.description: Provision of large-scale, privacy-protected healthcare data assets, analytics platforms, and services to generate real-world evidence for healthcare decision-making, including retrospective and prospective data collection, harmonization, and advanced analytics.

products.name: Technology Platforms and SaaS Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software applications and platforms supporting commercial and clinical processes such as CRM, performance management, compliance, safety reporting, multi-channel marketing, and master data management, delivered as SaaS with associated implementation services.

products.name: Healthcare Information and Analytics Offerings
products.description: Provision of proprietary healthcare data, market insights, and analytics services, including national and sub-national sales and prescribing data, reference databases, and advanced analytics to support commercial and clinical decision-making.

products.name: Consulting and Advisory Services
products.description: Strategic and implementation consulting services for life sciences companies, including advanced analytics, commercial process outsourcing, R&D strategy, portfolio and brand strategy, pricing, market access, and launch excellence, delivered by global teams with domain expertise.

products.name: Contract Sales and Medical Solutions
products.description: Outsourced sales force and medical engagement services, including recruitment, training, deployment, and management of sales and medical professionals, as well as tailored stakeholder engagement and market access solutions for biopharmaceutical and medical device companies.

products.name: Patient Engagement Services
products.description: Nurse-based and digital programs to engage patients, improve disease and medication understanding, support adherence, and assist with reimbursement navigation, delivered through multi-channel interactions across healthcare settings.

products.name: Medical Communications and Scientific Strategy Services
products.description: Services to support scientific engagement, including educator deployment, translation of clinical trial data into scientific platforms, publication strategy, and field medical teams for engagement with key opinion leaders and healthcare decision makers.

products.name: Retail Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of space in regional shopping malls, outlet centers, lifestyle centers, and open-air centers to retail tenants. This involves physical real estate assets managed and operated by the company, with revenue generated primarily from fixed and percentage rents, as well as tenant reimbursements for property expenses.

products.name: Property Management Services
products.description: Provision of property management services for owned and potentially third-party properties, including day-to-day operations, maintenance, and tenant relations. Delivered through in-person human labor and regulated real estate management practices.

products.name: Property Development and Redevelopment Services
products.description: Development and redevelopment of retail and non-retail real estate properties, including new construction, renovations, and repurposing of existing spaces. Involves physical construction, project management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Temporary Leasing and License Agreements
products.description: Short-term leasing of retail space and licensing agreements for temporary tenants, pop-up shops, and promotional activities. This is managed through flexible lease terms and in-person property management.

products.name: Advertising and Sponsorship Services
products.description: Sale of advertising space and sponsorship opportunities within the company's properties, including on-site promotions and marketing partnerships. Delivered through physical and digital channels at the properties.

products.name: Peripheral Land and Outparcel Sales
products.description: Sale of peripheral land and outparcels at or near company properties, often for development by third parties such as retail stores, banks, or restaurants. Involves real estate transactions and transfer of physical assets.

products.name: Operating Real Estate Asset Sales
products.description: Sale of operating real estate assets, including entire properties or portions thereof, to external buyers. This involves the transfer of physical real estate and is typically used to recycle capital or retire debt.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: A range of bank deposit instruments including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and specialized deposit products for businesses, individuals, municipalities, and title/escrow companies. These are delivered through physical banking centers and digital channels, and are regulated and insured by the FDIC.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A comprehensive suite of lending products for businesses, including commercial loans, lines of credit, working capital financing, accounts receivable lending, letters of credit, and equipment and vehicle leasing. These products require financial capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance, and are delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Agribusiness Lending
products.description: Loans and financing solutions tailored to agribusinesses, such as wholesale dairy farm operations, cattle feeders, livestock raisers, and farmers. These require specialized underwriting and knowledge of agricultural markets.

products.name: Real Estate and Construction Lending
products.description: Loans secured by commercial real estate and construction projects, including both owner-occupied and investor-owned properties. These require collateral evaluation, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: A variety of lending products for individuals, including automobile leasing and financing, lines of credit, credit cards, home mortgages, and home equity loans and lines of credit. These are delivered through branch and digital channels and require consumer credit underwriting.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Specialized services for commercial customers to monitor and manage cash flow, including treasury management systems, merchant card processing, payroll services, remote deposit capture, electronic funds transfers, and armored pick-up and delivery. These are delivered via digital platforms and in-person services.

products.name: International Banking Services
products.description: Services supporting international business activities, such as foreign exchange, international wires, and letters of credit for international trade. These require specialized infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: A suite of financial and fiduciary services offered through the CitizensTrust division, including trust administration, investment management, mutual funds, annuities, 401(k) plans, and individual investment accounts. These services require licensed professionals and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Investment Products Brokerage
products.description: Access to investment products offered by third-party providers, such as mutual funds, fixed income vehicles, and programs to diversify funds in federally insured time certificates of deposit at other institutions. These are delivered through sales offices and digital channels.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas extracted from company-operated wells in major shale plays, delivered to domestic and international markets via pipelines and contracts. This involves physical extraction, processing, and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of crude oil from company-operated wells, primarily in Southwest Appalachia and previously in Eagle Ford, delivered to customers under market-sensitive contracts. This requires physical extraction, processing, and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as ethane, propane, and butane, separated from raw gas streams and sold under index or spot contracts. This involves physical extraction, processing, and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas, Oil, and NGL Marketing Services
products.description: Provision of marketing services for natural gas, oil, and NGLs, including commodity price structuring, aggregation, contract administration, and securing gathering, hauling, storage, processing, and transportation services for third-party interest owners in company-operated wells. This is a service-based offering leveraging commercial and logistical expertise.

products.name: Midstream Transportation and Storage Services
products.description: Provides transportation, terminaling, and storage services for crude oil, refined petroleum products, natural gas, and natural gas liquids (NGL) through an extensive network of pipelines, terminals, marine vessels, railcars, and trucks. These services are delivered via regulated and unregulated infrastructure assets primarily in the United States.

products.name: Natural Gas and NGL Gathering, Processing, Fractionation, and Marketing
products.description: Gathers, processes, transports, fractionates, stores, and markets natural gas and NGLs, including exporting liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to global markets. Operations involve physical infrastructure such as gathering plants, fractionators, pipelines, and export terminals.

products.name: Petrochemicals and Plastics
products.description: Manufactures and markets petrochemicals and plastics, including ethylene, polyethylene, normal alpha olefins, aromatics, styrenics, and specialty chemicals, through joint ventures and owned facilities worldwide. Production involves large-scale chemical processing and cracking of hydrocarbon feedstocks.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Refines crude oil and other feedstocks into petroleum products such as gasoline, distillates (including diesel and aviation fuels), petrochemical feedstocks, and petroleum coke at refineries in the United States and Europe. Products are distributed via pipelines, trucks, rail, and marine vessels.

products.name: Marketing of Refined Products
products.description: Markets and sells refined petroleum products, including gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuels, through branded and unbranded retail and wholesale channels in the United States and Europe. Includes retail outlets, brand licensing, and joint ventures in convenience stores.

products.name: Lubricants and Base Oils
products.description: Manufactures and markets automotive, commercial, industrial, and specialty lubricants and base oils under various brands. Production is based on hydrocracking and other refining processes, with global distribution.

products.name: Renewable Fuels
products.description: Processes renewable feedstocks such as used cooking oil and vegetable oils into renewable diesel, renewable jet fuel, and other renewable fuels at dedicated facilities. Includes procurement of feedstocks, regulatory credit management, and global marketing of renewable products.

products.name: Human Biospecimen Procurement
products.description: Provision of human biofluids, solid tissues, and hematopoietic stem and immune cells (from both healthy and diseased subjects) to researchers, sourced from a global network of healthcare providers and biorepositories. Specimens are procured as remnant samples from clinical care or collected specifically for research under IRB-approved protocols, and are distributed with associated de-identified clinical data.

products.name: iSpecimen Marketplace Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, online marketplace platform that enables researchers to search for, select, and procure human biospecimens and associated de-identified data from a global network of suppliers. The platform integrates data ingestion, harmonization, search, order management, and workflow orchestration, supporting end-to-end bioprocurement processes for both researchers and specimen providers.

products.name: Next Generation Sequenced (NGS) Tissues
products.description: Provision of tumor tissue samples that have been fully DNA/RNA sequenced to identify specific biomarkers, paired with clinical annotation. These are offered as data-rich products for research, with utility even without the physical specimen.

products.name: Custom Specimen Collection Services
products.description: Custom collection of human biospecimens and associated data from specific patient cohorts, performed under IRB-approved protocols and tailored to researchers’ unique study requirements. This includes prospective collection and specialized procedures such as apheresis or bone marrow extraction.

products.name: De-identified Clinical Data Packages
products.description: Provision of de-identified clinical data associated with biospecimens, harmonized from electronic medical records, laboratory information systems, and biobank inventories. These data packages are delivered alongside specimens or as standalone datasets to support research and feasibility assessments.

products.name: VT-1953 Topical Gel
products.description: A topical gel formulation of besifloxacin, a dual DNA Gyrase/Topoisomerase inhibitor and immunomodulator, developed for the treatment of symptoms (malodor, pain) of malignant fungating wounds in advanced cancer and for moderate to severe inflammatory acne. Manufactured using pharmaceutical processes and delivered as a topical gel for local application.

products.name: VT-1908 Ophthalmic Drops
products.description: A sterile topical eye drop formulation of mycophenolate (inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase inhibitor) for treating immunoinflammatory conditions of the eye, primarily steroid-sparing anterior uveitis. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical sterile solution for ocular administration.

products.name: Molecular Replacement Therapeutics (MRT) Platform-Based Antifungal Products
products.description: Topical antifungal products (including dandruff lotion, shampoo, and Luliconazole cream) based on the MRT platform, which uses pegylated fatty acids to disrupt fungal cell membranes. These are manufactured by third parties and commercialized in India through licensing agreements, primarily as over-the-counter or prescription topical treatments.

products.name: Quantum Computing as a Service (QCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based access to D-Wave's quantum computing systems, including annealing and (in development) gate-model quantum computers, delivered via the Leap service. Customers submit computational problems and receive real-time solutions without needing to own or maintain hardware. This is a digital, cloud-delivered service with enterprise-grade reliability and security.

products.name: Quantum Computing Systems (Annealing and Gate-Model)
products.description: Physical quantum computers, including the Advantage2 annealing quantum computing system and, in the future, superconducting gate-model quantum computers, sold for on-premises installation to research, academic, government, and enterprise customers. These systems require advanced manufacturing, cryogenics, and integration with customer infrastructure.

products.name: Quantum Hybrid Solver Services
products.description: Cloud-based hybrid solvers that combine quantum and classical computing resources to solve large-scale optimization and nonlinear problems. Delivered via the Leap service, these solvers are used for complex, real-world applications such as scheduling, logistics, and portfolio optimization. This is a digital service leveraging both quantum and classical infrastructure.

products.name: Professional Services for Quantum Application Development
products.description: Consulting and implementation services to help customers identify, develop, and deploy quantum computing applications, including proofs-of-concept, pilot projects, and production integration. Delivered by in-person and remote expert teams, often as part of the D-Wave Launch program, and includes training and support.

products.name: Quantum Application Development Tools (Ocean SDK)
products.description: A suite of open-source software development tools (Ocean SDK) that enable developers to build, test, and deploy quantum and quantum-hybrid applications. Delivered digitally, these tools simplify programming for D-Wave systems and are available for free download.

products.name: Quantum AI and Generative AI Solutions
products.description: Emerging commercial applications and solutions that combine quantum computing with artificial intelligence, such as quantum-accelerated AI model training and generative AI for drug discovery and optimization. Delivered via cloud services and custom engagements, leveraging both quantum hardware and hybrid solvers.

products.name: Supply Chain Financing and Trading Services
products.description: Provides supply chain financing and trading services for bulk commodities such as coal, aluminum ingots, sand, and steel in China. This business involves executing trade agreements, providing working capital, and managing logistics and capital flow, using the company's own funds and various financing channels. Revenue is recognized either as gross sales or as agent services depending on control over goods.

products.name: Asset Management Services (Hong Kong)
products.description: Provided asset management and advisory services to professional investors in Hong Kong, including equity, debt, precious metals, currencies, derivatives, and external asset management. Services were delivered through a licensed subsidiary and involved managing client assets held in banks, placing trading instructions, and charging management and advisory fees. This business was exited in November 2024.

products.name: Brokerage and Investment Banking Services (Hong Kong)
products.description: Offers online brokerage services for Hong Kong and US equities, underwriting and distribution of Hong Kong IPOs, and underwriting of US dollar-denominated bonds issued by Chinese companies in Hong Kong. Services are provided through a licensed subsidiary with a proprietary trading platform and a large customer base.

products.name: Listing Readiness and Preparatory Consulting Services
products.description: Provides corporate consulting services to private companies preparing for potential public listings, including assistance with internal control readiness, financial reporting, corporate governance, and coordination with auditors and legal counsel. Services are delivered primarily through the Hong Kong subsidiary and are in an early stage of development.

products.name: Precision Timing Solutions
products.description: Integrated solutions combining MEMS resonators, oscillators, clock ICs, and embedded synchronization software, designed and delivered as complete timing systems for advanced electronics. These are manufactured using semiconductor processes in a fabless model and are programmable to customer specifications.

products.name: MEMS Oscillators
products.description: Semiconductor-based oscillators that integrate MEMS resonators with analog mixed-signal ICs to generate, amplify, and sustain accurate and stable clock signals. These are batch produced and custom programmed for various applications, offering high performance, resilience, and programmability.

products.name: Clock Integrated Circuits (Clock ICs)
products.description: Analog mixed-signal integrated circuits that deliver multiple clock signals using building blocks such as PLLs, clock dividers, and drivers. These ICs are developed using industry-standard semiconductor processes and can integrate MEMS resonators for enhanced performance and reliability.

products.name: MEMS Resonators
products.description: Silicon-based micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) resonators manufactured using proprietary semiconductor processes, providing the core frequency reference for oscillators and clock ICs. These are sold as standalone components or integrated into timing solutions, offering improved stability, reliability, and integration compared to quartz.

products.name: Synchronization Software Suite
products.description: Embedded software suite (e.g., TimeFabric) that provides IEEE 1588 standards-compliant network time synchronization and advanced holdover capabilities, delivered as part of timing hardware products to enable higher performance and reliability in networked electronic systems.
